scenarios.name: power-equals-cards-in-hand
scenarios.why: Robobrain War Mind's power is defined as the number of cards in its controller's hand: the three seeded hand cards plus the turn-1 draw make four.

scenarios.name: entering-gains-two-energy-for-two-artifact-creatures
scenarios.why: Casting Robobrain War Mind with two artifact creatures on the battlefield gains exactly two energy counters: the three-energy Automated Assembly Line activation stays unaffordable.

scenarios.name: entering-gains-three-energy-for-three-artifact-creatures
scenarios.why: With three artifact creatures on the battlefield the enter trigger gains three energy counters, exactly covering the three-energy Automated Assembly Line activation.
